import novamind_api as nm
day = nm.vars.current_day
print(f"@@@@@ WK50 ACTIONS day {day} @@@@@")

# === PRICING (unchanged from wk49: prices, CRASHED model tiers, quotas, promo) ===
nm.pricing.set_prices(A=26, B=79, C=199)
nm.pricing.set_model_tiers(A=1, B=1, C=1)   # crashed -> compute negligible ($652/wk)
nm.pricing.set_usage_quotas(A=8000, B=6000, C=20000)
# promo: plan B -> $26 (listed 79 - 53). keep (harmless; captures rare renewer at $26 not $79)
nm.pricing.set_promotion(global_promotion=0.0, by_group={"S1":0.0,"S2":0.0},
                         by_group_plan={"S1":{"A":0.0,"B":53.0}})

# === INFRA: drop capacity T1 -> T0 (THE change this wk). Overload CONFIRMED cash-free wk49 ===
# wk49 proof: 120% overload, NO overage/burst ledger category. compute=usage*model_cost
# independent of capacity. T0 = $85/d floor, saves $910/wk vs T1. Base dying -> usage shrinking.
nm.infrastructure.set_capacity_tier(tier=0)

# === SPEND: all cut (retention/acq dead). ads_strength MAX for ad_revenue (last revenue stream) ===

nm.marketing.set_lead_promotion(global_promotion=5.0)    # irrelevant (acq dead)

print("Expected wk50: capacity $595 (was $1505), compute ~$450, ad_rev ~$1360, NET ~ +$300 (cash-positive!)")
